About Me

I am a motivated Marketing graduate with knowledge of digital marketing, social media advertising, and creative content development. I have skills in Google Ads, social media campaigns, video editing using CapCut, and graphic design using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Canva.

I am eager to apply my marketing knowledge, communication skills, and analytical abilities in a professional corporate environment. I aim to contribute to organizational growth while continuously learning and developing my professional skills.

Alongside freelancing, I run Kopotakkho Bazar — an online grocery and fresh-market business with home delivery in Kotchandpur, Jhenaidah — where I handle the WooCommerce shop, Facebook marketing, creative design and day-to-day operations myself.
